chunks: I swear by God, I will surely destroy your idols after you have turned your backs and gone.
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Hud swear to do to the idols of his people?
ai.summary: Although the Arabic text provided is traditionally associated with Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him) destroying the idols of his people (as seen in Surah Al-Anbiya 21:57), the summary attributes it to Hud; in Shia exegesis, this act symbolizes the triumph of Tawhid over polytheism and the eventual eradication of false deities by the righteous. The phrase 'after they turn away' underscores the strategic patience of the Prophet, waiting for the idols' worshippers to depart before executing the destruction, a motif reflecting divine justice and the futility of idolatry.
